summary: Adds standalone local parametric CAD with exact modelling, geometry exchange and shared human/agent workflows connected to CAM.
warning: Installed post packages, saved CAM revisions, post execution events and controller output contracts are unchanged. CAD handoff creates a new detached CAM project; review its contours, threading and machining setup before generating output. A numerical roundoff correction can classify freshly calculated nearly tangent intersections differently; existing saved geometry and output are not rewritten. Exact section transfer refuses unsupported or ambiguous curves instead of approximating them. Gear v2 uses bounded involute and rack-generated trochoidal root approximations. Legacy v1 radial roots remain pinned until an explicit upgrade. API 2 plugin profiles require a reader supporting derived rules; earlier plugin previews reject them. Nominal geometry does not certify strength or mating clearance. Optional CAD parameter-group and creation-origin fields require a current CAD reader. Older strict CAD previews may reject these documents; original saved documents are not migrated automatically. Spur gear v3 adds an explicitly selected generating-cutter tip radius and tighter certified chord sampling. Existing v1/v2 recipes and installed snapshots retain their exact package definitions and geometry. Older CAD readers without the v3 builtin reject new v3 profiles; no automatic upgrade occurs. Sketch profiles may now store optional driving-dimension intent. Current readers preserve old geometry and expressions without adding constraints; older strict CAD previews may reject profiles using the new field. No saved document migration occurs. Cut in Pad, Revolve, Loft, Sweep and Boolean now requires confirmed positive intersected material. Saved cuts that previously removed nothing or could not be resolved at native precision may now report a feature diagnostic and stop rebuilding; their saved definitions remain unchanged. Check sketch placement, direction, depth and target. The preceding valid solid remains visible and invalid solid export is blocked.

Curve, Sweep, Through-all Pocket and world Datum Plane extend this unreleased CAD feature union; Sketch/Curve placement also adds an explicit datum-reference arm. Earlier CAD preview builds cannot read documents containing those new kinds or placements. Existing CAD documents remain readable without rewriting their geometry. UPID, post, package, engine API and existing workbench schemas are unchanged. CAD saves live in the additive cad/documents namespace. Plugin profiles extend the same unreleased CAD union, embedding an exact plugin API 1 or 2 package and expression-backed inputs. Earlier CAD preview readers reject plugin profiles. No UPID or post schema change is introduced. Plugin API 2 adds explicit derived relations, dependent bounds, conditions, choices and constraints. API 1 originals remain readable and unchanged; the gear implementation changes only through an explicit v2 package selection. CAD documents optionally store parameterGroups and parameterMetadata. Current readers retain old files without synthesizing metadata. Grouping and provenance require current readers; older strict preview readers can reject these optional fields. Spur gear v3 adds an explicitly selected generating-cutter tip radius and tighter certified chord sampling. Existing v1/v2 recipes and installed snapshots retain their exact package definitions and geometry. Older CAD readers without the v3 builtin reject new v3 profiles; no automatic upgrade occurs. checklist.events: Post execution-event contracts, compilation, audit and invocation are unchanged. CAD uses its own immutable versioned draft and bounded history. Handoff validates analytic millimetre geometry through the ordinary portable-UPID import operation. Delayed CAD build inspections recheck the active workspace before publication, and the CAD library owns a cancellable workflow scope that blocks background edits and history. Native feature previews use a separate lazy worker with one active and one coalesced latest candidate; provisional edits preserve the accepted document, exact build ownership and one-step Apply history. Context menus and source picking own the same UI workflow guards.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capability claims are unchanged. Desktop CAD adds automatic sketch regions, directly drawn line/three-point-arc paths, independent open reference curves with exact measurements and DXF exchange, editable analytic imported paths, STEP and closed STL import, selective fillets/chamfers, planar-face inward shells, exact topology inspection, Boolean operations, linear/circular solid patterns, ordered smooth/ruled lofts, exact line/arc sweeps with shared placement and conservative clearance preflight, target-dependent Through-all Pocket with directional extent and native material evidence, and parametric history. Versioned WebMCP tools reuse the same import, edit, build, selection, save and handoff checks. Compact feature registration retains complete per-kind discovery and strict execution validation. Sketch and Curve references render in authored world placement without loading the solid engine; selection reveals source sketches. Curves have no material or CAM roles. GPU-local positions preserve small far-origin faces, edges and reference geometry. World datum planes provide expression-backed origins and rotations for local Sketch/Curve placement and exact Pad/Revolve construction, aligned-section Loft and independently placed Sweep sources. Datum Loft fits in a common local frame before rigid placement, preserving native geometry across world orientation. Shared read-only plane and Loft inspectors expose accepted frames and ordered section eligibility; datum Sweep preserves authored section roll and rail traversal with conservative frame/clearance checks; unsupported datum Through-all Pocket inputs are rejected before editing. Datum references and their captures do not require native solid evaluation. CAD plugins add immutable package installation, a browser authoring/validation panel, bounded polygon recipes and a versioned Spur gear implementation. Read-only discovery and hash-pinned package chunk reads accompany guarded installation; all plugin-generated geometry uses existing sketch checks. Correlated plugin configuration shares its rule evaluator with guarded cad_inspect_plugin reads and atomic edits. The compact profile inspector and searchable library separate authoring from ordinary configuration. Fillet and Chamfer share one toolbar command group. Shared parameter inspection exposes active uses, local inputs, origins and applied values. Exact section DXF export shares the guarded native section operation. The unified history/dependency tree and on-part dimensions do not add modelling feature types. Existing feature forms preview native candidate geometry before Apply, retain the last valid provisional shape while pending, and restore accepted geometry on Cancel. Model/history reference picking observes preceding-feature eligibility and changes only the draft. Dedicated CAD Navigation/Display settings store mouse/trackpad navigation and on-part dimension visibility on the current device; rendered viewport identities expose those effective preferences. Native shape ownership and STL compound cleanup fixes preserve accepted snapshot exports and inspections. Spur gear v3 adds an explicitly selected generating-cutter tip radius and tighter certified chord sampling. Existing v1/v2 recipes and installed snapshots retain their exact package definitions and geometry. Older CAD readers without the v3 builtin reject new v3 profiles; no automatic upgrade occurs. Plugin package registration now uses compact discovery-only envelopes. The read-only cad_describe_plugin_api operation supplies complete strict API 1/2 contracts; actual install and edit validation is unchanged. The internal single-thread CAD kernel now uses file-pinned 1.1.0-wireedm.2 with coupled native ownership repair and additive exact indexed topology extractors. Loader, WASM, generated declarations, both source patches and reproducible build evidence are hash-pinned and distributed together. Legacy extractor geometry, model precision, full native validation and installed user packages remain unchanged. The transparent specification tree overlays the entire canvas with real Reference, Parameters and Model branches. Contextual tools sit at the bottom and configuration at the bottom right. Explicit rectangle, circle and slot dimensions reuse analytic geometry, named bindings and the shared guarded edit API. Direct contour dragging retains dimensions and commits once. Rectangle Sketch Fillet supports expression editing and deliberate unlink with correlated provisional measurements. General path constraint solving is not exposed. All existing Cut families share per-solid native material evidence with Through-all Pocket, rejecting no-effect and unresolved cuts while preserving preceding valid bodies. Contour-label changes reuse native geometry but retain complete accepted-document inspection checks.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Existing controller formatting, feed policy and exact-post output remain authoritative. CAD JSON preserves editable history; STEP exports exact BRep, STL exports a mesh, and sketch DXF preserves analytic curves. Failed solid features block solid export. Sketch and solid-section handoffs create separate CAM projects without overwriting prior revisions. Gear v2 nominal root/flank approximation notes survive sketch and final-section CAM transfer without extending UPID diagnostics.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration or installed-package rewrite. CAD storage covers browser cache and folder adapters with exact hash conflicts, journal recovery and write-boundary guards. Full workbench backup includes CAD files; cleanup retains the entire CAD namespace. CAD save and CAM creation are separate commits. The lazy OpenCascade worker is distributed with pinned corresponding sources and rebuild instructions. Installed plugin source lives under cad/plugins and is included in existing full-CAD retention/backup. Conflicting ID/version originals cannot be overwritten. Parts embed pinned packages, so library changes cannot rewrite existing geometry. Grouped parameters round-trip through both cache and folder adapters with existing exact-hash conflict checks. Plugin additions create isolated drivers and a group atomically, preserving unrelated parameters and all embedded packages. No automatic migration occurs. Durable CAD save receipts add storageName and draftMarkedSaved. A save committed to a disconnected or previous destination cannot mark the current draft saved or transfer its storage fingerprint. Section CAM handoff validates body, plane, resolved offset and result structure before either persistence operation.
checklist.verification: The current drawer, explicit plane selection and correlated scalar revision passes all 298 browser files / 3,334 tests and all 43 pure-domain files / 348 tests. The separate full native checkpoint passes 30 files / 337 cases, including component-level Cut evidence, ownership and parameter-cache guards. Production build, TypeScript, all92 documentation/discovery/schema/link checks and exact native source distributions pass. Independent scoped review repaired View Escape cancellation, scientific input normalization, unfinished-preview disposal and stale-base retention. Actual UI/agent journeys verify plane labels and surface picking, one-step Undo, unchanged drawer framing at normal/laptop sizes, preserved shared bindings, whole-part previews, blocked conflicting edits and current section parameters with reused solids. Written E2E discovery lists32 journeys; this pass does not claim all32 executed. Exact gear backups and saved originals remain preserved. The broader CAD improvement goal remains active; no physical manufacture or universal CAD parity is claimed.

testedPosts.scope: Unchanged post passes all three conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation. CAD does not bypass the existing saved-revision, active-setup or audited output requirements. No physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: Design parametric parts and send exact contours into the machining workbench.
changes: Design in CAD opens a desktop workspace with a compact document header, one ordered feature/dependency tree and a stable canvas. Every configuration floats over the view and can minimize; changing selection no longer shifts the layout.

Create dimension-driven sketches, connected lines and three-point arcs with automatic material nesting, and exact solids with pads, target-dependent Through-all pockets, revolves, ordered smooth/ruled lofts, exact line/arc sweeps, Booleans, selected-edge fillets/chamfers, inward shells, transforms, mirrors and linear/circular patterns. Reuse named parameters in dimension expressions.
Create expression-driven datum planes, place sketches and curves on them, and build tilted pads, revolves, aligned-section lofts or sweeps while preserving local dimensions and source files.
Send a sketch or previewed final-solid section directly into a new CAM project with analytic lines and circular arcs.

Save editable CAD documents locally; import and export CAD JSON, STEP, STL and sketch DXF. Edit imported line and arc dimensions while preserving source originals. Open existing sketches fitted to their geometry, reveal source sketches in 3D, and capture the current view as PNG.

Agents can discover schemas, construct and measure exact line/arc profiles, preflight sweep placement and clearance, import geometry, edit the same draft, inspect exact faces and edges, control the viewport, save and hand off designs through version-checked WebMCP tools.

Configure correlated Spur gear profiles with automatic undercut correction, Automatic/Custom generating-cutter tip radius, bounded rack-generated rounded roots and read-only dimensions. Tooth root and Curve accuracy have dedicated controls with illustrated explanations. Existing parts keep their exact plugin versions until explicitly upgraded.
Open Fillet / Chamfer as a grouped toolbar menu; both operations retain exact selected-edge and all-edge behavior.

Read CAD failures in dismissible toasts and the notification bell. Repeated identical rebuild failures are grouped; dismissing the toast retains the notification for the current app session. Gear root sampling uses fewer certified chords at the same requested tolerance; oversized extrusions report an actionable topology limit without silently changing precision.

Organize document parameters in named groups with plugin origin indicators. Plugin profiles create their own scoped driving values. Inspect active uses and local overrides, edit values in a floating editor, and use contextual info buttons with current-geometry illustrations.

Keep mouse-drawn contours free until you add a driving dimension. Rectangle, circle and slot dimensions use shape-native annotations; named links remain correlated. Drag selected ordinary contours to move them with one Undo step. Sketch Fillet rounds rectangle corners with a bounded tangent radius; explicit relation editing/unlinking retains other dimensions.

Preview existing modeling feature edits before Apply; right-click parts and profiles for compact actions, and pick eligible source sketches/bodies from the model or history without leaving the draft. Settings > CAD provides Navigation and Display tabs for this device.

Use File > Export DXF for a chosen sketch, reference curve or previewed exact solid section at a plane offset. Export is independent of feature properties, does not save the document or create CAM, and keeps version, cancellation and workflow checks.

Sketch profile selection keeps pointer focus on the canvas and uses a continuous analytic SVG boundary, removing oversized browser focus outlines and segment seams without changing export geometry. Spur gear v3 uses fewer certified modeling chords at the same accuracy.

Changed plugin recipes must use a new ID/version when their identity belongs to a bundled package. Conflicting installation is rejected before writes; conflicting stored originals remain intact and appear in library diagnostics.

The specification tree floats directly over the full design area. Its Reference, Parameters and Model branches scroll independently, with distinct contour selection and parent editing context. Contextual commands sit at the bottom; configuration and sketch completion sit at the bottom right without shifting the canvas.

Pad/Pocket and Revolve source selection excludes empty, suppressed and construction-only sketches. Explicit unusable selection reports a problem instead of substituting another sketch; datum sketches keep Distance while Through-all is disabled with contextual help.
CAD requests the browser exit warning only while unsaved content or a pending workflow exists. Save or Undo to the saved baseline releases it; the warning does not save the draft.

Pad, Revolve, Loft, Sweep and Boolean cuts report when they miss the target, point away from it, only touch it or remove the entire body. Native precision checks inspect individual material components; no requested geometry or accuracy is changed automatically.
Renaming a sketch contour reuses the existing native solid; changing a real dimension still rebuilds it. STEP body labels and stale inspection checks remain current.

Sketch is the first modeling command. Select a reference plane before starting, or pick its patch or label in the design area when asked. View controls tuck below the contextual tool dock and slide out without changing canvas framing.

Modeling quantity fields retain shared parameter links and preview all correlated features together. Use fx for deliberate relation changes. Unfinished values keep the last valid shape visible while Apply remains disabled. Unused parameters reuse native solids while current section queries and stale-state checks remain exact.
